Support and Well-being

You are not alone. We are here to walk with you through the hard times.

There is hope

Life can be hard, and sometimes we all need help. Whether you are dealing with stress, loneliness, loss, addiction or other challenges, we want you to know there are people who care about you.

We offer emotional, spiritual and recovery support programs in a safe, confidential and non-judgmental setting.

Available programs

  • Addiction recovery program: A 12-step program based on the principles of the gospel of Jesus Christ, designed to help those struggling with addiction of any kind
  • Spiritual support: Personal conversations with missionaries or Church leaders who can listen to you and offer perspective
  • Support groups: Weekly meetings with other people facing similar challenges
  • Well-being resources: Access to materials and tools to improve your emotional and spiritual health

The recovery program

Our addiction recovery program is based on the 12 steps and helps people struggling with substances, compulsive behaviors or other dependencies. Meetings are free, confidential and open to everyone.

The program recognizes that true recovery comes through the healing power of Jesus Christ. It does not replace professional help, but it complements any treatment you are receiving.

Confidentiality guaranteed

Everything you share with us is kept strictly confidential. No personal information is required to take part. All you need is the desire to receive help.

Take the first step

If you or someone you know needs help, don't hesitate to contact us. We are here to listen.
